title: Plan U: AI Short-Video Matrix
summary: Topic library → batch scripts → batch videos → multi-platform distribution → data review
scenario: For running several accounts at once on Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Bilibili with one content factory that produces in volume.

steps.title: Build a topic library
steps.detail: Have the model generate dozens of niche topics in batch and tag each one (pain-point, trend, tutorial, persona), then check real heat with Perplexity against platform trends and search data. Save the survivors into a ranked spreadsheet.
steps.tips: Rank topics by expected click-through and only make the top 20% — don't spread your effort thin.

steps.title: Batch script generation
steps.detail: Generate voice-over scripts from the topic library with one template: 3-second hook, body, call to action. Tweak tone per platform — fast and punchy for Douyin, deeper for Bilibili, aspirational for Xiaohongshu.
steps.tips: Ask for 5 hook variations per script and keep the most conflict-driven one.

steps.title: Batch video production
steps.detail: Produce visuals or avatar voice-overs in batches with fixed characters, backgrounds and caption styles for a consistent series look. Default to one master version that can be reused everywhere, then make platform-specific cuts.
steps.tips: Perfect one full pipeline before going to volume — ten failures at once help no one.

steps.title: Multi-platform distribution
steps.detail: Export adapted versions per platform following best posting times, aspect ratio, hashtags and covers; generate A/B titles and covers with the model, then finalize manually.
steps.tips: Change the title and first 3 seconds for each platform — the same video verbatim is the easiest way to get ignored.

steps.title: Data review
steps.detail: Pull views, completion rate, likes and follower growth; feed the numbers to the model and let it tell you which topics, hooks and covers worked, then feed that back into the library and templates.
steps.tips: Review on a fixed weekly cadence and turn winners into reusable formulas.

pitfalls.title: One-size-fits-all distribution
pitfalls.detail: Platforms differ in style, length and copy; adapt each asset per platform.

pitfalls.title: Volume before validation
pitfalls.detail: Scaling before one flow works means scaling the failures.

pitfalls.title: No feedback loop
pitfalls.detail: Posting without reading data keeps the topic library stuck at guesswork.

pitfalls.title: Matrix means more accounts
pitfalls.detail: A real matrix is a hero account with coordinated satellites, not a pile of random accounts.
